content: I will write a script `scratch/find_subitems_in_logs.js` to search all historical conversation logs for any JSON payloads or text snippets that contain `"subItems"` or `"calculations"`. This will tell us if the detailed budget formulas were ever recorded in the AI chat context in past sessions.
